text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio conquers the Kikuka Sho and
claims
her Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Teio! Congratulations on your Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for such a moving
performance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yaaay! The great Tokai Teio is
now a Triple
Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio gives a triumphant cry and
thrusts
three fingers up in the air.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! I'd like to express my sincerest
gratitude
for all the hard work that
you've done, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well, I am a Triple Crown
champion, after
all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm up there with Prez, my
mission is
finally complete!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Nah, just messing with ya! As if my goal was ever to just be on her level!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna stop as her equal. I'm
gonna
surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after becoming a Triple Crown
champion,
Tokai Teio won't shake off
her true dream!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll show them all the power of a
Triple
Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I wanna figure out what race I should
aim for
next. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking into account she just blew the

long-distance Kikuka Sho race out of the
water...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That was Prez's first senior G1 race
too!
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm just one step behind her. All right.
The senior
chapter of the great Teio's
legend is about to
begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on our first senior-year
race
goal—the spring Tenno Sho!
